en: The manager sent a memo to all staff about the new parking rules.
exzh: 經理發了一份備忘錄給全體員工，說明新的停車規定。
note: circulate a memo 傳閱備忘錄

en: The receptionist asked every visitor to sign in before entering the building.
exzh: 接待人員請每位訪客在進入大樓前先簽到。

en: Could you make ten photocopies of this report before the meeting starts?
exzh: 可以請你在會議開始前把這份報告影印十份嗎？

en: The copier is out of paper, so please refill it before using it.
exzh: 影印機沒紙了，使用前請先補紙。

en: Please order a new ink cartridge before the printer runs out completely.
exzh: 請在印表機完全沒墨之前訂購新的墨水匣。

en: I still have a lot of paperwork to finish before I leave today.
exzh: 我今天下班前還有很多文書工作要完成。

en: The legal department issued a memorandum explaining the new data policy.
exzh: 法務部發出一份公文，說明新的資料政策。

en: Please delete the old files from the shared drive to free up space.
exzh: 請刪除共用硬碟裡的舊檔案以釋出空間。

en: We plan to automate the billing process to save time and reduce errors.
exzh: 我們打算讓請款流程自動化，以節省時間並減少錯誤。

en: Our computers are outdated, so we plan to replace them next quarter.
exzh: 我們的電腦已經過時，所以打算下一季更換。

en: We had to rearrange the schedule because the speaker arrived late.
exzh: 因為講者晚到，我們必須重新安排時程。

en: I seem to have misplaced the contract, so I will print another copy.
exzh: 我好像把合約放錯地方找不到了，所以我會再印一份。

en: Please enter your login and password to access the company's internal system.
exzh: 請輸入您的登入帳號與密碼以進入公司內部系統。

en: Please proofread the brochure carefully before we send it to the printer.
exzh: 在我們把手冊送印之前，請仔細校對。

en: The shipment was delayed for unspecified reasons, and we are checking with the carrier.
exzh: 貨物因未說明的原因延誤，我們正在向貨運公司查詢。

en: The technician checks the security system periodically to make sure it works.
exzh: 技術人員定期檢查保全系統以確保運作正常。

en: You need written authorization from your manager to order new equipment.
exzh: 訂購新設備需要經理的書面核准。

en: Please include your postal code on the form so the package reaches the correct address.
exzh: 請在表格上填寫郵遞區號，包裹才能送到正確的地址。

en: Please update the spreadsheet with the latest sales figures before the meeting begins at three.
exzh: 請在三點會議開始前，用最新的銷售數字更新試算表。

en: We hope to streamline the ordering process so that customers receive their goods more quickly.
exzh: 我們希望簡化訂購流程，讓客戶能更快收到商品。

en: The printer on the second floor is out of toner, so please use the one downstairs.
exzh: 二樓的印表機沒碳粉了，請改用樓下那一台。

en: The architect showed the client a blueprint of the new office building during the meeting.
exzh: 建築師在會議中向客戶展示了新辦公大樓的設計圖。

en: Extra paper and printer ink are kept in the storeroom at the end of the hall.
exzh: 備用紙張和印表機墨水放在走廊盡頭的儲藏室。

en: Departmental budgets must be submitted to the finance office before the end of the month.
exzh: 各部門預算必須在月底前提交給財務室。

en: Our technician will run a diagnostic test to find out why the server keeps crashing.
exzh: 技術人員會執行診斷測試，找出伺服器一直當機的原因。

en: Invoices will now be sent electronically instead of by regular mail to save paper.
exzh: 為了節省紙張，發票現在將以電子方式寄送，而非一般郵寄。

en: Please print the formal letter to the client on the company letterhead.
exzh: 請將給客戶的正式信函印在公司專用信紙上。

en: If you lose your Internet connection, please restart the modem and wait for two minutes.
exzh: 如果網路連線中斷，請重新啟動數據機並等待兩分鐘。

en: The marketing team will redesign the company website to make it easier for customers to use.
exzh: 行銷團隊將重新設計公司網站，讓顧客更容易使用。

en: Unauthorized persons are not allowed to enter the laboratory without a visitor badge.
exzh: 未經授權的人員沒有訪客證不得進入實驗室。

en: Please unplug all electrical equipment before leaving the office for the long holiday.
exzh: 長假離開辦公室前，請拔掉所有電器設備的插頭。

en: We need to reschedule the meeting because several team members will be away.
exzh: 因為有幾位組員不在，我們必須將會議改期。
note: reschedule A for B 把A改到B

en: Please review the agenda for the upcoming board meeting before Friday.
exzh: 請在週五前先看過即將舉行的董事會議議程。

en: Each attendee will receive a name tag and a copy of the schedule.
exzh: 每位與會者都會拿到名牌和一份時程表。

en: Please let me know your availability for a phone interview next week.
exzh: 請告知您下週可以進行電話面試的時間。
note: check availability 確認是否有空位／有貨

en: The presenter used several charts to explain the sales results.
exzh: 主講人用了幾張圖表來說明銷售成果。

en: Let's finalize the budget before we present it to the board.
exzh: 我們在向董事會報告之前，先把預算定案吧。
note: finalize a plan 敲定計畫

en: All department heads are invited to the annual luncheon on Thursday.
exzh: 所有部門主管都受邀參加週四的年度午餐會。

en: The first slide gives a brief overview of this quarter's sales results.
exzh: 第一張投影片簡要概述了本季的銷售成果。
note: give an overview of 概述

en: The directors will meet in the boardroom at nine tomorrow morning.
exzh: 董事們明天早上九點會在會議室開會。

en: We will hold an informal meeting with the clients over coffee.
exzh: 我們會和客戶一邊喝咖啡一邊開個非正式的會議。

en: The survey measures the effectiveness of our new advertising campaign.
exzh: 這項調查衡量我們新廣告活動的成效。

en: Please paraphrase the customer's complaint so that everyone in the meeting can understand it easily.
exzh: 請把客戶的抱怨換個說法，讓會議中每個人都能輕鬆理解。

en: We received an affirmative answer from the supplier, so the order will ship on schedule.
exzh: 我們收到供應商肯定的答覆，所以訂單將如期出貨。
note: in the affirmative 表示同意

en: The marketing team will brainstorm ideas for the new advertising campaign on Thursday morning.
exzh: 行銷團隊將在週四早上腦力激盪，構思新廣告活動的點子。
note: brainstorming session 腦力激盪會議

en: We ask the committee to reconsider its decision in light of the new information.
exzh: 我們請委員會根據新的資訊重新考慮其決定。

en: Please send me a revised timeline for the project by the end of the day.
exzh: 請在今天下班前把修訂後的專案時程表寄給我。

en: We will hold a videoconference with our overseas partners at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
exzh: 我們明天早上九點將與海外夥伴舉行視訊會議。

en: I have attached your travel itinerary, including flight times and hotel details.
exzh: 我已附上您的行程表，包含班機時間與飯店資訊。

en: Guests staying at the hotel receive a complimentary breakfast every morning.
exzh: 住宿的旅客每天早上都可享用免費早餐。

en: Hotel occupancy is usually highest during the summer holiday season.
exzh: 飯店住房率通常在暑假旺季最高。

en: There is a small fee for cancellation within twenty-four hours of the reservation.
exzh: 在預約時間前二十四小時內取消需收取少許費用。

en: The hotel offers a half-day excursion to the nearby mountains every Saturday.
exzh: 飯店每週六提供前往附近山區的半日遊。

en: The company covers airfare and hotel costs for all overseas business trips.
exzh: 公司負擔所有海外出差的機票與住宿費用。

en: Checkout is at eleven, but you may leave your bags at the front desk.
exzh: 退房時間是十一點，不過您可以把行李寄放在櫃檯。

zh: 飯店服務台人員；禮賓人員
en: The concierge helped us reserve a table at a popular restaurant nearby.
exzh: 飯店禮賓人員幫我們在附近一家熱門餐廳訂了位。

en: Each banquet guest may choose a chicken or fish entrée for dinner.
exzh: 每位宴會賓客的晚餐主菜可選擇雞肉或魚肉。

en: Guests staying at the hotel can enjoy a free massage at the spa on weekends.
exzh: 入住飯店的房客週末可在水療中心免費享受按摩。

en: Heavy traffic congestion on the highway caused our delegation to arrive late for the conference.
exzh: 高速公路嚴重塞車，導致我們的代表團開會遲到。

en: The hotel's amenities include a fitness center, a pool, and free wireless Internet in every room.
exzh: 這家飯店的設施包括健身中心、游泳池，以及每間客房的免費無線網路。

en: Guests who book the deluxe suite will receive a complimentary breakfast every morning.
exzh: 預訂豪華套房的房客每天早上可享免費早餐。

en: Please ask the purser if you need extra blankets during the long flight to Singapore.
exzh: 飛往新加坡的長途航程中，如需額外毯子，請詢問事務長。

en: Travelers should bring a plug adapter because the outlets in that country are different.
exzh: 旅客應攜帶電源轉接頭，因為那個國家的插座形式不同。

en: Bus riders are encouraged to use the new mobile app to check arrival times.
exzh: 公車乘客可多利用新的行動應用程式查詢到站時間。

en: The annual awards dinner will be held in the grand ballroom of the downtown hotel.
exzh: 年度頒獎晚宴將在市區飯店的大宴會廳舉行。

en: The doorman at the hotel will help you with your luggage and call a taxi.
exzh: 飯店的門僮會幫您提行李並叫計程車。

zh: 短期休閒旅行；度假去處
en: The company is offering a weekend getaway to the mountains as a prize for the best team.
exzh: 公司提供前往山區的週末小旅行，作為最佳團隊的獎勵。

en: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the delay in delivery.
exzh: 對於配送延遲所造成的任何不便，我們深表歉意。
note: apologize for the inconvenience 為不便致歉

en: Our Internet service provider will fix the connection problem this afternoon.
exzh: 我們的網路服務供應商今天下午會處理連線問題。

en: Our monthly newsletter includes updates about new products and upcoming sales events.
exzh: 我們的每月電子報包含新產品與即將舉行的特賣活動消息。

en: The salesperson showed the customer three different models of the washing machine.
exzh: 銷售人員向客人展示了三款不同型號的洗衣機。

en: We handed out flyers near the station to promote the grand opening.
exzh: 我們在車站附近發傳單，宣傳開幕活動。

en: Customers can see the new furniture collection in our downtown showroom.
exzh: 顧客可以在我們市中心的展示間看到新的家具系列。

en: We are preparing promotional materials for the product launch next month.
exzh: 我們正在為下個月的新品上市準備宣傳資料。

en: The purchaser must pay the full amount within thirty days of delivery.
exzh: 買方必須在交貨後三十天內付清全額。

en: The customer returned a faulty printer and asked for a full refund.
exzh: 客人退回一台有瑕疵的印表機，並要求全額退款。

en: You can buy the latest business magazines at the newsstand near the station.
exzh: 你可以在車站附近的書報攤買到最新的商業雜誌。

en: Many pharmacies sell generic medicine at a lower price than brand names.
exzh: 許多藥局販售比品牌藥便宜的學名藥。

en: Customers can call our hotline at any time to report a problem.
exzh: 顧客隨時可以撥打我們的服務專線通報問題。

en: Customers can customize the design of their uniforms for a small extra fee.
exzh: 顧客只要加付少許費用，就可以客製化制服的設計。

en: The manufacturer decided to discontinue the old model after sales dropped sharply.
exzh: 銷售量大幅下滑後，製造商決定停產舊款機型。

en: New members can enjoy an introductory price for the first three months.
exzh: 新會員前三個月可享入會優惠價。

en: Please check the price sticker on the box before you take it to the cashier.
exzh: 把盒子拿去結帳前，請先確認上面的價格標籤。

en: The car dealership will hold a special sale on all used vehicles this weekend.
exzh: 這家汽車經銷商本週末將舉辦所有中古車的特賣。

en: Customers who buy the printer this month will receive a rebate of twenty dollars.
exzh: 本月購買這款印表機的顧客可獲得二十美元的回饋金。

en: If you believe the store overcharged you, please bring your receipt to the service desk.
exzh: 如果您認為店家多收了費用，請攜帶收據到服務台。

en: The deposit is fully refundable if you cancel your reservation at least forty-eight hours in advance.
exzh: 如果您至少在四十八小時前取消訂位，訂金可全額退還。

en: The bank has agreed to waive the annual fee for customers who open an account this month.
exzh: 銀行同意免收本月開戶客戶的年費。
note: waive a fee 免收費用

en: This cordless drill comes with two batteries and a carrying case at a special price.
exzh: 這支無線電鑽附兩顆電池和一個收納箱，現正特價。

en: You can personalize the gift box by adding the recipient's name and a short message.
exzh: 您可以在禮盒上加上收件人姓名和簡短訊息，做成專屬禮盒。

en: We will expedite your order so that it arrives before the opening of the new store.
exzh: 我們會加快處理您的訂單，讓它在新店開幕前送達。

en: The store sells furniture on consignment and returns unsold items to the owners after three months.
exzh: 這家店以寄售方式販售家具，三個月後把賣不出去的物品退還給物主。

en: She has ten years of experience working in the automotive industry as a sales manager.
exzh: 她在汽車業擔任業務經理已有十年經驗。

en: The store is offering a thirty percent discount on all footwear until the end of the week.
exzh: 這家店所有鞋類商品到本週結束前都打七折。

en: The rental company has a compact sedan available for the weekend at a low rate.
exzh: 租車公司週末有一輛小型轎車以優惠價出租。

en: We stopped working with that supplier because its deliveries were late and unreliable.
exzh: 我們不再與那家供應商合作，因為它交貨延遲又不可靠。

en: Please send the invoice to our accounting department by the end of the week.
exzh: 請在本週結束前把發票寄到我們的會計部門。
note: issue an invoice 開立發票

en: Employees who work overtime will be paid one and a half times their normal rate.
exzh: 加班的員工將領到平常時薪的一點五倍。

en: The company will relocate its main office to a larger building downtown.
exzh: 公司將把總辦公室遷到市中心一棟較大的大樓。

en: The marketing team hired an intern to help with the summer campaign.
exzh: 行銷團隊僱用了一名實習生來協助夏季活動。

en: Your first paycheck will arrive on the last working day of the month.
exzh: 您的第一筆薪水會在這個月最後一個工作日發放。

en: She completed a three-month internship at a local advertising agency.
exzh: 她在當地一家廣告公司完成了為期三個月的實習。

en: Your payment is now overdue, so please settle the balance as soon as possible.
exzh: 您的款項已逾期，請盡快結清餘額。

en: The company will reimburse you for all travel expenses with proper receipts.
exzh: 只要附上收據，公司會報銷您所有的差旅費用。
note: reimburse A for B 就B補償A

en: The conference attracted many young businesspeople from around the region.
exzh: 這場研討會吸引了許多來自各地的年輕企業人士。

en: She has five years of managerial experience in the retail industry.
exzh: 她在零售業有五年的管理經驗。

en: A recruiter from the firm contacted me about a position in sales.
exzh: 那家公司的招募人員聯絡我，詢問業務職缺的事。

en: Every stockholder will receive a copy of the annual financial report.
exzh: 每位股東都會收到一份年度財務報告。

en: The payroll department processes salaries on the twenty-fifth of every month.
exzh: 薪資部門在每個月二十五日處理薪資發放。

en: The company cut costs during the economic downturn to avoid laying off staff.
exzh: 公司在經濟衰退期間削減成本，以避免裁員。

en: The balance is payable within thirty days of receiving this invoice.
exzh: 餘額須在收到此發票後三十天內支付。

en: We must economize on travel costs if we want to stay within budget.
exzh: 如果想要控制在預算之內，我們必須節省差旅費用。

en: The foreman checked that all workers were wearing safety helmets on site.
exzh: 工頭檢查所有工人在工地都有戴安全帽。

en: The charity plans to fundraise for new school supplies by hosting a dinner next month.
exzh: 這個慈善團體打算下個月舉辦晚宴，為新的學用品募款。

en: The new manager will introduce several organizational changes to improve communication between the departments.
exzh: 新經理將推行幾項組織調整，以改善各部門之間的溝通。

en: She works as a freelance designer and takes on projects from several different clients.
exzh: 她是自由接案的設計師，同時承接好幾位不同客戶的案子。

en: The monthly fee will be debited from your account on the first day of each month.
exzh: 月費將在每個月的第一天從您的帳戶中扣款。

en: Because of falling sales, the company was forced to downsize and close two of its branches.
exzh: 由於銷售下滑，公司被迫縮減規模並關閉兩間分公司。

en: Our company offers flextime so that employees can choose when to start and finish their workday.
exzh: 我們公司提供彈性工時，員工可自行選擇上下班的時間。

en: To receive reimbursement for your travel costs, please submit all receipts to the accounting department.
exzh: 若要報銷差旅費用，請將所有收據交給會計部門。

en: Business attire is required for all employees who will meet clients at the main office.
exzh: 所有要在總公司會見客戶的員工都必須穿著正式服裝。

en: The company announced a layoff of fifty workers because of the slowdown in demand.
exzh: 由於需求趨緩，公司宣布資遣五十名員工。

en: If we overpay you by mistake, the extra amount will be taken from your next paycheck.
exzh: 如果我們誤多付給您，多出的金額會從下一次薪水中扣除。

en: Suppliers who deliver late will be penalized according to the terms of the contract.
exzh: 延遲交貨的供應商將依合約條款受到處罰。

en: The relocation of our headquarters to the harbor district will be completed in March.
exzh: 我們總公司遷往港區的工作將在三月完成。

en: Applicants must prepare a short audition piece for the selection committee next Tuesday.
exzh: 應徵者必須為下週二的評選委員會準備一段簡短的試演。

en: The law firm is hiring a paralegal to help prepare documents for upcoming cases.
exzh: 這間律師事務所正在招募法務助理，協助準備即將開庭案件的文件。

en: My sister works as a stockbroker and advises clients on how to manage their investments.
exzh: 我姊姊是股票經紀人，為客戶提供投資管理的建議。

en: Some employees feel apprehensive about the planned changes to the work schedule.
exzh: 部分員工對工作時程的調整計畫感到憂心。

zh: 新進人員訓練；就職引導
en: All new employees must attend the induction session on their first day at work.
exzh: 所有新進員工必須在上班第一天參加新人訓練。

en: The company's wellness program offers free yoga classes and health checks for all staff.
exzh: 公司的健康促進計畫為全體員工提供免費瑜伽課與健康檢查。
note: wellness program 健康促進方案

en: The hotel lobby will be closed during the renovation next month.
exzh: 飯店大廳在下個月整修期間將會關閉。

en: The company plans to renovate its old office building next spring.
exzh: 公司計畫明年春天整修舊辦公大樓。

en: Please do not leave your luggage unattended anywhere in the airport.
exzh: 請勿讓您的行李在機場任何地方無人看管。

en: A sudden malfunction in the elevator delayed several employees this morning.
exzh: 電梯突然故障，讓幾位員工今天早上遲到了。

en: A local realtor showed us several offices available for rent downtown.
exzh: 一位當地的不動產經紀人帶我們看了市中心幾間出租的辦公室。

en: The restaurant will remodel its dining room and reopen in two months.
exzh: 這家餐廳將重新裝潢用餐區，兩個月後重新開張。

en: Each diner will receive a free dessert with the dinner special tonight.
exzh: 今晚每位用餐的客人都會隨晚餐特餐獲贈一份免費甜點。

en: He studied at a culinary school before becoming head chef at the hotel.
exzh: 他在成為飯店主廚之前就讀烹飪學校。

en: The company offers its employees a generous healthcare plan that covers family members as well.
exzh: 公司提供員工優渥的醫療保健方案，家屬也涵蓋在內。
note: healthcare plan 醫療保險方案

en: The renter must pay the deposit before receiving the keys to the apartment on Monday.
exzh: 承租人必須先付押金，才能在週一拿到公寓鑰匙。

en: All tenants must vacate the building by noon so that the workers can repair the roof.
exzh: 所有房客必須在中午前離開大樓，好讓工人修理屋頂。
note: vacate the premises 離開場所

en: Homeowners in this area are invited to a meeting about the new recycling program.
exzh: 這個地區的屋主受邀參加關於新回收計畫的說明會。

en: Each occupant of the building will receive a notice about the planned water shutdown on Friday.
exzh: 大樓的每位住戶都會收到週五預定停水的通知。

en: The hotel will close its lobby next week in order to redecorate it for the holiday season.
exzh: 飯店下週將關閉大廳，以便為節慶季重新布置。

zh: 公寓大廈；分戶出售的住宅
en: He bought a condominium near the city center so that he could walk to the office.
exzh: 他在市中心附近買了一戶公寓，這樣就能走路上班。

en: A fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall next to the elevator on every floor.
exzh: 每層樓電梯旁的牆上都裝有一具滅火器。

en: The city plans to demolish the old warehouse and build a public park on the site.
exzh: 市府計畫拆除舊倉庫，在原地興建公園。

en: A power outage in the area delayed the opening of the store by two hours.
exzh: 該地區的停電使商店延後兩小時開門。

en: Officials worry that adding more tables will overcrowd the small dining area of the restaurant.
exzh: 官員擔心再增加桌位會使餐廳的小用餐區過於擁擠。

en: The hotel is proud of the cleanliness of its rooms, which are inspected every day.
exzh: 這家飯店以客房的整潔為傲，每天都會檢查。

en: The library now lends e-book copies of its training manuals to every new employee.
exzh: 圖書館現在把訓練手冊的電子書版本借給每位新進員工。

en: Please fill out the registration form correctly so that we can process your request quickly.
exzh: 請正確填寫報名表，我們才能快速處理您的申請。

en: My coworker offered to cover my shift so I could attend the training session.
exzh: 我的同事主動幫我代班，讓我能參加訓練課程。

en: Employees must lock their laptop in a drawer before leaving the office each evening.
exzh: 員工每天傍晚離開辦公室前，必須把筆電鎖進抽屜。

zh: 使人分心的事物；（測驗）干擾選項
en: A noisy printer can be a major distractor for workers who need to concentrate.
exzh: 吵鬧的印表機對需要專心的員工來說可能是很大的干擾。
note: 日常指干擾源；考試中指錯誤的干擾選項

en: Please save the signed contract in the shared folder before the end of the day.
exzh: 請在今天下班前把簽好的合約存到共用資料夾。

en: The manager asked Tom to rewrite the proposal with clearer figures before Friday's presentation.
exzh: 經理要求湯姆在週五簡報前用更清楚的數字重寫企劃書。

en: The company headquarters will move to a larger building downtown next spring.
exzh: 公司總部明年春天將搬到市中心較大的大樓。
note: 原字表為 headquarter；常用 headquarters，字尾 s 不省略，可視為單數

en: The error is commonly caused by entering the wrong customer number into the system.
exzh: 這個錯誤通常是因為在系統中輸入了錯誤的客戶編號。
note: 同義 usually；commonly used 普遍使用的

en: The photocopier on the third floor is out of paper, so please use the other one.
exzh: 三樓的影印機沒紙了，請使用另一台。

en: I saved the sales report on my desktop so I could find it quickly during the meeting.
exzh: 我把銷售報告存在桌面上，開會時才能很快找到。

en: If the sender is unknown, do not open the attachment in the email.
exzh: 如果寄件者不明，請不要開啟郵件中的附件。

en: The reviewer suggested several changes to the draft before it was sent to the client.
exzh: 審閱者在草稿寄給客戶前提出了幾項修改建議。

en: The programmer fixed the bug in the booking system within a few hours.
exzh: 程式設計師在幾小時內修好了訂位系統的錯誤。

en: Our tech support team is available around the clock to help customers with problems.
exzh: 我們的技術支援團隊全天候協助客戶解決問題。
note: technology 的口語縮寫；tech support 技術支援

en: Our email filter automatically moves suspicious messages to the spam folder every day.
exzh: 我們的郵件過濾器每天自動把可疑郵件移到垃圾郵件匣。

en: Product details and prices are listed on the company webpage under the Support tab.
exzh: 產品詳情與價格列在公司網頁的支援分頁下。

en: A careless mistake in the invoice caused a delay in the payment to the supplier.
exzh: 發票上一個粗心的錯誤造成給供應商的付款延遲。

en: After the merger, the department had to organize its files anew.
exzh: 合併之後，該部門必須重新整理檔案。
note: start anew 重新開始；偏書面

en: The workload should be divided evenly among all members of the project team.
exzh: 工作量應該平均分配給專案團隊的所有成員。

en: The clerk misidentified the package, so it was sent to the wrong department.
exzh: 店員搞錯了包裹，所以它被送到錯誤的部門。

zh: 縮寫形（如 don't）；收縮；（經濟）緊縮
en: Writing a contraction like "can't" is fine in a casual email but avoid it in contracts.
exzh: 在輕鬆的電子郵件裡寫 can't 這類縮寫形沒問題，但合約中應避免。
note: 經濟上指景氣緊縮，反義 expansion

en: You can scan the ticket with a smartphone instead of printing it at the office.
exzh: 您可以用智慧型手機掃描票券，不必在辦公室列印。

en: According to the company by-law, all expense claims must be approved by a supervisor.
exzh: 依照公司內規，所有費用申請都必須經主管核准。
note: 也寫作 bylaw，常用複數 by-laws

en: I hereby confirm that I have received the documents listed in the attached letter.
exzh: 我特此確認已收到附函所列的文件。

en: The company issued a restatement of its earnings after finding errors in the accounts.
exzh: 公司在帳目中發現錯誤後，發布了盈餘的重編報告。
note: 日常指「重新陳述」；財報 restatement 指更正重編

en: The weekly staff meeting begins at nine o'clock sharp in the main conference room.
exzh: 每週的員工會議九點整在大會議室開始。
note: 只用於整點，如 at ten o'clock

en: Please ask the caller to leave a message if the manager is not at her desk.
exzh: 如果經理不在座位上，請讓來電者留言。
note: 常見 caller ID（來電顯示）

en: From the sales figures, we can draw an inference that customers prefer the cheaper model.
exzh: 從銷售數字可以推論出顧客比較偏好較便宜的機型。
note: draw an inference 做出推論

zh: 規劃者；企劃人員；行事曆
en: Our event planner has booked a venue for the annual dinner in December.
exzh: 我們的活動企劃人員已經訂好十二月年終晚宴的場地。

en: If you are unsure about the schedule, please contact the project manager directly.
exzh: 如果您不確定時程，請直接聯絡專案經理。

en: Mr. Lin is unavailable this afternoon, so please reschedule the meeting for tomorrow.
exzh: 林先生今天下午沒空，請把會議改到明天。

en: Ideally, the new employee should finish the training before the busy season begins in June.
exzh: 理想上，新進員工應在六月旺季開始前完成訓練。

en: Participants were asked to read the report silently before the discussion began.
exzh: 與會者被要求在討論開始前默讀報告。

en: She said bye to the clients and ended the conference call before leaving.
exzh: 她向客戶道別後便結束電話會議，然後離開。
note: say bye to 向…道別；較口語

en: Be careful: a generalization based on only five survey responses may mislead the whole team.
exzh: 要小心，僅根據五份問卷回覆做出的概括可能誤導整個團隊。

zh: 反射性的；下意識的；（文法）反身的
en: Saying yes to every request is a reflexive habit that can lead to overwork.
exzh: 對每個要求都答應是一種下意識的習慣，可能導致過勞。
note: 文法上 reflexive pronoun 為反身代名詞（myself 等）

en: The board will formally announce the new director at tomorrow's press conference.
exzh: 董事會將在明天的記者會上正式宣布新任主管。
note: 注意與 formerly（以前）拼字相近

en: The press release must be factual and should not exaggerate the product's benefits.
exzh: 新聞稿必須如實，不應誇大產品的好處。

en: The audience listened intently as the CEO described the plan for the next year.
exzh: 執行長說明明年的計畫時，聽眾專注聆聽。

en: Guests can book a half-day sightseeing tour at the hotel front desk.
exzh: 房客可在飯店櫃檯預訂半日觀光行程。
note: 原字表為 sightsee；常用 sightseeing（名詞）、go sightseeing

en: Passengers are reminded to store their luggage safely under the seat during the flight.
exzh: 提醒乘客在飛行期間把行李安全地放在座位下方。

en: The hotel has a sauna and a pool that guests may use until ten p.m.
exzh: 這間飯店有桑拿室和泳池，房客可使用到晚上十點。

en: The conference will be held at a seaside resort about an hour from the airport.
exzh: 研討會將在距機場約一小時車程的海濱度假村舉行。

en: Several flights were delayed because of a severe thunderstorm over the airport last night.
exzh: 由於昨晚機場上空有強烈雷雨，數個航班延誤。

en: The resort offers maps and free water bottles to every hiker who joins the mountain tour.
exzh: 度假村提供地圖和免費水壺給每位參加山區行程的健行者。

en: The hotel apologized for the unpleasant smell in the room and moved us upstairs.
exzh: 飯店為房內難聞的氣味道歉，並讓我們換到樓上的房間。

en: The new seats allow passengers to travel comfortably on long business trips.
exzh: 新座椅讓乘客在長途出差時能舒適地旅行。
note: comfortably afford 輕鬆負擔得起

zh: 客房清潔服務；家務管理
en: Please call housekeeping if you need extra towels or would like your room cleaned.
exzh: 如果您需要額外毛巾或需要打掃房間，請致電房務部。
note: 原字表為 housekeep；常用名詞 housekeeping（飯店的客房清潔部門）

en: The hotel is a two-minute walk from the underground station.
exzh: 這間飯店離地鐵站只要步行兩分鐘。
note: 英式用法 underground 指地鐵（美式 subway）

en: Guests will find free toiletries, including soap and shampoo, in every room.
exzh: 房客會在每間客房裡找到包括肥皂與洗髮精在內的免費盥洗用品。
note: 原字表為 toiletry；常用複數 toiletries

en: Remember to pack sunscreen and a hat before the outdoor team-building trip.
exzh: 別忘了在戶外團隊建立活動前，帶上防曬乳和帽子。

en: The store is offering a mini version of its popular blender for frequent travelers.
exzh: 這家店為常出差旅行的人推出熱門果汁機的迷你版。
note: 常見 mini size（迷你尺寸）、mini version（迷你版）

en: Some customers felt the advertised discount seemed unreal, so they read the fine print carefully.
exzh: 有些顧客覺得廣告上的折扣好得不真實，因此仔細讀了小字條款。

en: Every shopper who spends over fifty dollars will receive a free canvas bag today.
exzh: 今天每位消費滿五十元的顧客都可獲贈一個帆布袋。

en: Customers who are unhappy with their purchase may return it within thirty days.
exzh: 對購買的商品不滿意的顧客可在三十天內退貨。

en: The company ships its products worldwide and offers free delivery on orders over one hundred dollars.
exzh: 這家公司把產品寄送到全球，訂單滿一百元免運費。

en: The seller promised to deliver the used furniture to the buyer's office on Thursday.
exzh: 賣家答應週四把二手家具送到買方的辦公室。
note: 反義 buyer；best seller 暢銷品

en: The store is holding a sale on dress pants for business wear this weekend.
exzh: 這家店本週末舉辦商務西裝褲特賣。
note: 原字表為 pant；常用複數 pants，一件用 a pair of pants

en: The café buys its coffee beans locally to keep delivery costs and prices low.
exzh: 這家咖啡館在當地採購咖啡豆，以壓低運送成本和價格。

zh: 女士（對女性的禮貌稱呼）
en: Thank you for waiting, ma'am; your table by the window is ready now.
exzh: 女士，感謝您久候，您靠窗的座位現在準備好了。
note: 對應 sir；用於服務場合的禮貌稱呼

en: Customers who are dissatisfied with the service may request a full refund within a week.
exzh: 對服務不滿意的顧客可在一週內申請全額退款。
note: 原字表為 dissatisfy；常用 dissatisfied with（對…不滿）

en: The new magazine focuses on healthy lifestyle choices for busy office workers.
exzh: 這本新雜誌專注於介紹忙碌上班族的健康生活方式選擇。
note: lifestyle product 生活風格商品

en: The firm has expanded internationally and now has offices in six different countries.
exzh: 這家公司已拓展到海外，目前在六個國家設有辦公室。

en: The new store sells affordable clothing designed for teen customers and their parents.
exzh: 這家新店販售專為青少年顧客及其父母設計、價格實惠的服飾。
note: teenager 的簡稱；也作形容詞

en: The freighter carrying our shipment is expected to reach the port on Tuesday morning.
exzh: 載運我們貨物的貨輪預計週二早上抵達港口。

en: The shop sells each skateboard at half price during its end-of-season sale.
exzh: 這家店在季末特賣期間，每塊滑板都半價出售。

en: Unused items may be returned for a full refund if you keep the original receipt.
exzh: 若保留原始收據，未使用的商品可退貨並獲全額退款。

en: The new product sold poorly at first because few customers knew about it.
exzh: 這項新產品起初賣得不好，因為很少顧客知道它。

zh: 徹底改革；帶來革命性改變
en: The new software promises to revolutionize the way small companies manage their accounts.
exzh: 這套新軟體承諾將徹底改變小公司管理帳務的方式。

en: All salespeople must submit their monthly reports to the regional manager by Friday.
exzh: 所有業務員必須在週五前把月報交給區域經理。

en: This wristwatch is water resistant and comes with a two-year warranty from the manufacturer.
exzh: 這支手錶防水，並附有製造商兩年保固。

en: The shop sells homemade jam and bread made from locally grown ingredients.
exzh: 這家店販售用當地種植食材製成的自製果醬和麵包。

en: The trainer will demonstrate the new software to all sales staff on Monday morning.
exzh: 講師將在週一早上向所有業務人員示範新軟體。

en: Each test taker must show a photo ID before entering the examination room.
exzh: 每位應試者進入考場前都必須出示附照片的證件。
note: 原字表為 taker；常用 test taker、note-taker（做會議記錄的人）

en: The career fair gives every job seeker a chance to meet employers in person.
exzh: 就業博覽會讓每位求職者都有機會與雇主面對面接觸。
note: 原字表為 seeker；常用 job seeker

en: His inexperience with the accounting software made it difficult for him to finish the report on time.
exzh: 他對會計軟體不熟悉，因此很難準時完成報告。

en: The firm's renown for fast service helped it win several large contracts last year.
exzh: 這家公司以快速服務聞名，去年因此贏得數筆大合約。
note: 較常見形容詞 renowned（著名的）

zh: 較輕的；較少的（light 的比較級）；打火機
en: A lighter workload this month will give the staff time to complete their training.
exzh: 這個月較輕的工作量會讓員工有時間完成訓練。
note: lighter workload 較輕的工作量；另有「打火機」之意

en: Unpaid invoices will be sent to the collections department after sixty days.
exzh: 逾六十天未付款的發票將轉交催收部門。

en: The supplier's invoice is in euros, so please check the exchange rate before payment.
exzh: 供應商的發票是以歐元計價，請在付款前確認匯率。

en: We are looking for a hardworking assistant who can manage several projects at once.
exzh: 我們正在尋找能同時管理多項專案、工作勤奮的助理。

en: Indirect costs such as electricity and rent are not included in the quoted price.
exzh: 電費和租金等間接成本不包含在報價內。
note: indirect cost 間接成本；反義 direct

en: The café on the second floor serves hot lunches to employees at reasonable prices.
exzh: 二樓的咖啡館以合理的價格供應員工熱的午餐。

en: Staff may use the fitness center on the ground floor free of charge after work.
exzh: 員工下班後可免費使用一樓的健身中心。

en: The hotel offers free ice cream to guests by the pool every afternoon in summer.
exzh: 這間飯店夏天每天下午在泳池邊免費提供房客冰淇淋。

en: Please turn off the air conditioner before you leave the meeting room tonight.
exzh: 今晚離開會議室前請關掉冷氣。
note: 原字表為 conditioner；TOEIC 常見 air conditioner、hair conditioner（潤髮乳）

en: The break room has a new dishwasher, so please do not leave cups in the sink.
exzh: 休息室新增了洗碗機，所以請不要把杯子留在水槽裡。

en: A repairperson will arrive between nine and noon to fix the broken elevator.
exzh: 維修人員會在九點到中午之間抵達，修理故障的電梯。

en: Please keep the walkway clear of boxes so that visitors can enter the building safely.
exzh: 請保持走道上沒有箱子，讓訪客能安全進入大樓。
note: covered walkway 有頂蓋的走廊

en: Please place the drinks in the cooler before the guests arrive at the picnic.
exzh: 請在賓客抵達野餐地點前，把飲料放進冷藏箱。
note: water cooler 飲水機（辦公室閒聊的場所）

en: The new refinery will employ about four hundred workers when it opens next year.
exzh: 這座新煉油廠明年啟用時將僱用約四百名員工。
note: oil refinery 煉油廠；動詞 refine

en: The baker delivers fresh bread to the hotel restaurant every morning before six.
exzh: 麵包師傅每天早上六點前把新鮮麵包送到飯店餐廳。

en: The hotel chef is publishing a cookbook of local dishes for sale in the gift shop.
exzh: 飯店主廚正出版一本在地料理食譜書，將在禮品店販售。

en: The cafeteria sells a cheeseburger and a drink for a special lunch price on Fridays.
exzh: 自助餐廳週五以午餐特價販售起司漢堡加飲料。

en: The café offers a free donut with every coffee purchased before nine in the morning.
exzh: 這家咖啡館在早上九點前每買一杯咖啡就送一個甜甜圈。

en: The banquet staff replaced every tablecloth before the guests arrived for the dinner.
exzh: 宴會人員在賓客到達晚宴前更換了每一張桌巾。

en: The maintenance work will be done in the daytime to avoid disturbing night guests.
exzh: 維修工作將在白天進行，以免打擾夜間住宿的房客。
